title: Super Splendor XTEC 125
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Hero MotoCorp Super Splendor XTEC 125 is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. At its heart lies a 125cc powertrain delivering 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 110 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
